content.text: :1: . Open your web browser and go to the address bar. Type `github.com` and press Enter .

content.caption: Search for GitHub by typing 'github.com' in the search bar or address bar and pressing Enter.

content.text: :2: . Alternatively, search for GitHub on search field and click the official link `https://github.com` .

content.caption: Search for GitHub by typing 'GitHub' in the search field and clicking the official link `https://github.com` from search results.

content.text: 2: Signing up for a GitHub account
:3: - Once on the GitHub homepage, locate the sign-up options. Click the green ==Sign up for GitHub== button in the center of the page or ==Sign up== button in the top-right corner of the homepage.

content.caption: Click the Sign up button on the top right or the center of the GitHub homepage. (2026 Interface)

items: Enter your email:Type your email address in the input box.
Create a password:Choose a password that meets GitHub's strength requirements: at least 15 characters long, or at least 8 characters with a mix of numbers and lowercase letters.

Enter a username:Type your chosen username. Make sure to read  **Before Creating an Account * docs.html?id=before-creating-account** since username can affect your website in long-term. The system will check availability in real-time. If available, a green checkmark will appear.
select your country/region from the dropdown menu.
Click create account button to proceed.

content.caption: Enter your email, create a password, choose a username, select your country/region, and click the Create account button to proceed.

content.text: :5: -  Choose the appropriate verification method for you.

items: GitHub requires users to complete a visual or audio puzzle to confirm they are not automated bots. Click on either the visual or audio option to proceed.

content.caption: Choose the appropriate verification method for you. Click on either the visual or audio option to proceed.

items: Complete the prompt (for example, rotating an image to the correct orientation or selecting matching patterns). and click submit to proceed.
Once successfully verified, An email will be sent to your provided email address containing an 8-digit numerical code.

content.caption: Complete the verification process by following the instructions and clicking submit to proceed.

content.text: :7: -  Confirm Your Email and Finish Setup.

items: Open your email client and find the confirmation email from GitHub.
The email contains an 8-digit numerical code (e.g., 1234-5678).
Enter these numbers into the verification boxes on the GitHub page.
click the continue button to complete the account setup process.

Incase you do not receive the email within a few minutes, check your spam or junk folder. If you still cannot find it, you can request a new verification email from GitHub. by clicking the 'Resend verification email' link below the continue button.

content.caption: Enter the 8-digit code from the confirmation email into the verification boxes on the GitHub page and click the continue button to complete the account setup process.

items: After continuing, you will be automatically redirected to the login page where you can log in to your new GitHub account to continue.

content.caption: Log in to your new GitHub account using the credentials you provided during the sign-up process to continue.

items: To log in for a new session, you can go to the GitHub homepage and click the 'Sign in' button located at the top right corner of the page.
This will take you to the login page where you can enter your username/email and password to access your account.

content.caption: click the 'Sign in' button located at the top right corner of the page.

items: enter your username/email and password and click the 'Sign in' button to log in to your GitHub account
Incase if you forget your password, you can click the 'Forgot password?' link on the login page to reset it. Follow the instructions provided to regain access to your account.

content.caption: Enter your username/email and password and click the 'Sign in' button to log in to your GitHub account.
